summary: This is the palace's machine room — thirty-three files, mostly ceremony specs plus the working notebooks that support them. The ceremony system itself is in good shape: every ceremony card contracts through Palace Ceremonies, uses the same "Trigger / Preconditions / Postconditions" shape, and CLAUDE.md's trigger table matches it exactly. The real find is a specific blind spot: three visual-language standards (Mermaid, Image Embedding, Technical Diagram) and the Deposit Ceremony + README all *say* they're one system in prose, but the links only run one direction — Technical Diagram Standard emits four outbound links and receives zero. Two ceremony docs (Revival Ceremony, Substrate Skill) name [[ELDER]] as a hard precondition in their own contract text but never link it — and ELDER is sitting at only 3 inbound palace-wide, so this is exactly the kind of quiet, load-bearing gap a weave exists to catch. The family also has real clutter, matching what Loudon named this morning: a four-month-old audit (Palace Audit — 2026-05-28) whose triage items Loudon already approved inline but that were apparently never executed and never composted; a working notebook (Toolkit Assessment) wearing full entry frontmatter while its own first line says "Not a palace entry"; an executed-and-closed Schema Ceremony Proposal still staged as an open `seed`; and a three-part Graffiti Pass handoff chain from a pass that appears finished. None of this needs force — the fixes are mostly "point the link back" and "update the stage to match what already happened."

open_question_resolutions.question: Should the Walk ceremony be updated to acknowledge the Swarm Weave as a future path — the difference between walking alone and walking with a colony?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Weave Ceremony already distinguishes itself from Walk Ceremony as the parallel-worker/coordinator form (born 2026-03, spawned Swarm Weave). The distinction the question asks for already exists structurally between the two ceremony docs; what's still open is whether Walk Ceremony's own text should point forward to it — a small prose addition, not a design question.

open_question_resolutions.question: Is there a ceremony for onboarding a new collaborator to the palace — not a human, but a new Claude instance encountering it for the first time with a specific task?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: CLAUDE.md's 'Born with' section and JEWEL.md cover the birth of every session, and this very Weave room's dispatch pattern (a room file + a targeted read list) is close to what's being asked for — but neither is named as a ceremony. Genuinely still open; worth naming rather than resolving here.

bridge_findings.shared_structure: ELDER (a priority newcomer at 3 inbound) is the literal precondition named in the contract text of two of this family's most load-bearing docs (Substrate Skill, 16 inbound; Revival Ceremony) — the family already depends on it operationally, the link graph just hasn't caught up.
